retained_failures: The first three cases fail because the test incorrectly expects working() false after closing_ becomes true; the window closed. The harness waits for actual closed window and editor quiescence instead.

Corrected 10k/100k pass; 500k times out the real watchdog while the test performs full PRAGMA integrity_check on the GUI thread. Retained thread sample identifies Context::checkData, not application startup. Moving the same audit to a worker resolves it without weakening checks or changing production.

The first nine native PASS runs verify size/bounds but screenshots show transient placeholder cards. The test is strengthened to require populated visible cards, and its missing-source folder is isolated from log-write events. Only the stronger final nine runs qualify this contract.
limits: Metadata-only catalogs do not qualify hundreds of thousands of actual photo decodes, sustained workflows, physical I/O, RSS slope or startup/scroll latency budgets.
Whole-run wall time includes setup, audit and shutdown and is not startup latency.
Hardware remains one 8 GiB M3 Mac, built-in Retina display. No 16 GiB or external-display qualification is inferred.
16 applicable blocking IDs remain without adapters after this checkpoint; complete QA, BUG045 and final artifact/update gates remain open.
